title: Model ML opens Dubai office
summary: Model ML, the agentic operating system for financial and professional services, is expanding in the Middle East with a new Dubai office and the appointment of Raghav Sehgal as General Manager for the region.
content: Model ML, the agentic operating system for financial and professional services, is expanding its presence in the Middle East. The company has opened a new office in Dubai and appointed Raghav Sehgal as the General Manager for the region to lead its growth and operations.

title: Qashier launches AI general manager
summary: Qashier, the unified merchant operating system serving more than 25,000 businesses across Southeast Asia, today launched QashierGM, an AI general manager that works with a merchant's whole team.
content: Qashier, a unified merchant operating system serving businesses across Southeast Asia, has launched QashierGM. This new artificial intelligence general manager is designed to work seamlessly with a merchant's entire team, helping to streamline operations and enhance productivity for thousands of businesses in the region.

Commercial Bank of Dubai joins CBMT Network
summary: Commercial Bank of Dubai’s (CBD) participation in the Commercial Bank Money Token (CBMT) initiative marks the first Middle East bank joining the network, extending CBMT beyond Europe.
content: Commercial Bank of Dubai (CBD) has joined the Commercial Bank Money Token (CBMT) network, making it the first Middle East bank to participate in the initiative. This move expands the CBMT network beyond Europe, marking a significant milestone for the digital token platform as it grows its international presence with regional banking support.

title: Ziina Secures Triple CBUAE Licensing Across Payments, Stored Value, and Exchange
summary:
Ziina becomes the first UAE fintech to secure CBUAE licenses across retail payments, stored value, and exchange, enabling unified digital wallets, merchant acquiring, and cross-border transfers.
The post Ziina Secures Triple CBUAE Licensing Across Payments, Stored Value, and Exchange appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Ziina has become the first UAE fintech to secure triple licensing from the CBUAE across retail payments, stored value, and exchange. This major regulatory milestone enables the company to offer unified digital wallets, merchant acquiring services, and cross-border money transfers, strengthening its financial services footprint in the region.

summary:

Asha Anderson, 48, of Pompano Beach, was found guilty of theft of government funds and Social Security fraud after a six-day trial, says the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern […]
The post Florida Woman Drains $152,000 in Social Security Benefits From Deceased Relative, Faces Multiple Years Behind Bars appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Federal prosecutors have secured a conviction against a Florida woman for unlawfully withdrawing over $152,000 in Social Security retirement benefits intended for a deceased relative. Asha Anderson, of Pompano Beach, was found guilty of theft of government funds and Social Security fraud following a six-day trial. She now faces the possibility of spending multiple years behind bars.
